prose: The Wall Street Journal reports that Amazon plans to invest $100M in a robotics manufacturing facility in Indiana, slated to open by 2028. Context: Amazon's robots already operate at more than 300 facilities and touch roughly 75% of customer orders, so the plant expands in-house production of the machines its logistics network increasingly depends on. The article is paywalled, so this summary is based on the headline and lead captured by the feed.
highlights: Amazon to invest $100M in an Indiana robotics plant.
Amazon robots run at 300+ facilities today.
Robots involved in about 75% of customer orders.
WSJ piece is paywalled; summary from headline/lead only.
